headline: Christmas Memory
tagline: Flip, match & jingle all the way

scenes.title: 9 North Pole Friends
scenes.say: Begin with preschoolers here. Big smiling faces and only nine pairs keep the first round easy.

scenes.title: 12 Christmas Mini Scenes
scenes.say: Ask kids to say what's happening in each little scene. Talking about it helps matches stick.

scenes.title: 16 Christmas Treats
scenes.say: Set it out at the party table, and let the winner choose a real cookie afterwards.

scenes.title: 12 Santa's Workshop Toys
tips: Act out the toy you flip
scenes.say: Act out each toy you turn over, like drumming or flying a plane. Lots of giggles.

scenes.title: 9 Nativity & Angels
scenes.say: Gentle pictures make this a calm quiet-time round, lovely for Sunday school or bedtime.

scenes.title: 12 ESL Picture + Word Cards
tips: Read the word on every flip
scenes.say: Read the word aloud on every flip. New readers and English learners pick up holiday vocabulary fast.

scenes.title: 12 Color-In Winter Animals
scenes.say: Kids color both copies the same way first, so their own artwork becomes the game.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Print each page twice to make pairs
Most sets come in color and B&W
tips.say: Print each page twice to make pairs, and pick the black and white version to save ink.

say.title: Free printable Christmas memory games for cozy December afternoons.
say.hook: Print twice, cut, and start flipping.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
